cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Find the Real Authority
cards.instruction: Probe until you know who can approve, block, or reverse the outcome.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll get this pipe repair moving. Which signatures release the money?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: All three. I've spent the whole morning getting them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good work. I won't send you round again. Is there anyone who can still freeze the payment after those signatures?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Finance. They unfroze the roof money when the caretaker called, though.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll follow that up myself. Does the caretaker overrule finance, or know the person who can? Just point me to the right door; I'll handle the explanation and let you get back to your day.

reason: Have A protect B from repeated work and take over the follow-up while probing the real power behind a successful caretaker call.
